**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is looking to organize contacts from past networking events.

[EVENT] User attended a speed networking event where they met 12 new people.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant offered to help create a spreadsheet template to organize contacts.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a suggested template for a contact tracker with the following columns: Name, Title/Company, Event/Meeting, Follow-up Actions, Notes.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on meeting 12 new people at the speed networking event.

[USER] User requested to add a column for the contact's industry or field.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant agreed and updated the template to include a column for Industry/Field.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Updated contact tracker template now includes: Name, Title/Company, Industry/Field, Event/Meeting, Follow-up Actions, Notes.

[USER] User requested to add a column to track the source of how they met the person.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant agreed and updated the template to include a column for Source.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Updated contact tracker template now includes: Name, Title/Company, Industry/Field, Source, Event/Meeting, Follow-up Actions, Notes.

[USER] User requested to add a column to track the current status of the connection.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant agreed and updated the template to include a column for Connection Status.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Updated contact tracker template now includes: Name, Title/Company, Industry/Field, Source, Event/Meeting, Connection Status, Follow-up Actions, Notes.

[USER] User requested to add a column to track the priority level of the connection.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant agreed and updated the template to include a column for Priority.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Updated contact tracker template now includes: Name, Title/Company, Industry/Field, Source, Event/Meeting, Connection Status, Priority, Follow-up Actions, Notes.

[USER] User requested to add a column to track specific goals or outcomes with each connection. 

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant acknowledged the request but did not provide an immediate response regarding the update.
